Won-Ton Soup
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 10:37am

Ingredients




1 pkt Won tons
1 pound Ground Pork
1 Egg beaten
1 tablespoon Soy sauce
teaspoon Salt
teaspoon Pepper
6 cups Chicken broth
2 tablespoons Soy sauce
2 tablespoons Chopped shallots

Preparation

1 Mix pork,egg,soy sauce,salt & pepper. Fill won - tons. Cook in boiling water until won-tons float to top. Remove from water. Heat chicken stock and add won tons, ladle into soup bowls and add shallots and soy sauce.
